profile.headline: SWE @ BlackRock | UC Berkeley EECS Alumnus

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · On-site
positions.description: Software Engineer working on BlackRock’s Aladdin software alongside multiple software teams.

positions.title: Course Instructor
positions.description: Instructor for the Pre-Engineering Program’s Computer Science class. This was a summer program with the College of Engineering for incoming engineering students about to start their journey at IC Berkeley.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Teaching · Team Management

positions.title: Instructor & Mentor
positions.description:
Mentor and instructor for High school and Middle school students in the Bay Area. Specifically targeting under-resourced schools, I taught Python based curriculums revolving games, data science, and other projects. I also assisted students with college applications and overall career advice.

In addition to helping students, I also helped manage, direct, and host weekly general meetings for the organization. These meetings typically revolved around pedagogy (teaching styles/practices), check-ins with the other instructors/mentors, and overall announcements regarding the organization.
positions.insights: Skills: Mentoring · Youth Mentoring · Teaching · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Director of IT
positions.description:
Managed and lead the IT team of LBSA at UC Berkeley. I planned tech related events/panels and managed the website by making sure that everything was constantly up to date.

Recently, I worked on making the membership process completely through our website and automated. As of now, people can apply and access the resources through the website which discards the manual revision of payments and allows for an all-in-one experience for users and admin.
positions.insights: Skills: Team Leadership · Event Planning · Website manage

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineering Intern with Portfolio Management (Optimization Team) using AI to manage portfolios by translating user prompts to tasks and overall automating most of the process. More specifically, I trained GPT4’s AI model to manage portfolio cases, subscriptions, and optimization plans. The final project consisted of allowing a user to give a prompt in native language, which then would translate to a series of API calls for manipulating/managing specified portfolios.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · React.js · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Prompt Engineering

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Junior Software Developer working on website framework for UC Berkeley Cooperative Housing. An all new website for housing residents and property managers to overlook required tasks/jobs.

Junior Software Developer working on an app for Girls Write Now (GWN) nonprofit organization in order to bring more awareness and a wider audience to female writers. From audio books, articles, and even podcasts, we give a new way of exploring and connecting with young female authors.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Teamwork · React.js · Website Building · Mobile Applications · React Native · Databases

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineering Intern on Aladdin (Identity Engineering Team) working with client accounts and their specified parameters.

positions.title: Course Instructor
positions.description: One of 3 instructors for the Pre-Engineering Program’s Computer Science class and team project lead for a team of 4 students designing a prototype on an improved white cane using a various number of sensors. This was a summer program with the College of Engineering for incoming underrepresented engineering students.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Teaching · Team Management

positions.title: Manager & Tutor
positions.description: Founder/Manager/Tutor for Salinas Valley Tutoring Non-Profit which was created at the midst of the COVID-19 pandemic in order to aid high school students struggling in their academics during the virtual period.
positions.insights: Skills: Teaching · Team Leadership · Team Management
